sampling.camera_centre: Independent uniform 3D balls, radius 50.8mm about nominal centres
sampling.aim: Normal(0,8mm) per board-plane axis; board upright
sampling.wire: True height[.8,1.2]mm, width[.6,1]mm; model assumes 1/.8mm and nominal centre
sampling.photometry: Gamma[.85,1.2], gain[.75,1.2], RGB gains[.92,1.08], mild vignetting, blur, noise, JPEG94
sampling.darts: Eight fixed target types cycle; tilt x/y[-.25,.25], length[65,80]mm, flight width[3,6]mm

detector_inputs: Corrected grayscale pixels, nominal H and K from FOV78deg/centre/aim, nominal raised-wire geometry. The nominal K supports broad acquisition, matching calibrate CLI; no true pose or H supplied.
lens_assumption: Exact synthetic K/D supplied to undistortion. Unknown-lens estimation is not tested.
metrics: Plane errors in mm over visible grid/perimeter probes; max per view. Rejections retained. Oracle scoring uses true H for evaluation only.
timing: Concurrent acquisition wall time per camera, one OpenCV thread per worker; excludes rendering/undistortion, not live FPS.
limitations: Independent per-camera calibration, not the proposed joint solver.
One textured synthetic board; assumed lens/wire ranges, not measured C920 data.
Static before/after pairs, no live event timing, hands or full depth-tested occlusion.
